product_metadata.title: Vivifying Mesh Laundry Bags, 2 Pack 23.6" x 19.7" Large Honeycomb Mesh Wash Bags for Washing Machine, Delicates Clothes, Sweater, Coats, Stuffed Toys, Blanket (White)
features: ➤LARGE CAPACITY - Each large mesh laundry bag measures 23.6 x 19.7in, it’s designed for delicates clothes, sweater, coats, curtain, blanket and more

➤HONEYCOMB MESH DESIGN - This laundry bags made of durable honey comb mesh polypropylene, non-deformable and long-lasting, soap and water can flow easily through the mesh, and the honeycomb design has abetter rubbing function for optimal cleaning
➤PROTECTION AND FINISHING - Mesh laundry bag protects your garments from tangling, snagging or pulling, while also minimizing the chance of colors oozing out of each other

➤RUSTPROOF ZIPPER AND ELASTIC - Polyester zipper and elastic can better protect your clothes and washing machine, avoid clothing with hard decorations from scratching the inner of your washing machine when washing
➤FRIENDLY TIPS - Please do remember to slide the zipper head into the flap to keep it from catching and unzipping during washing and drying cycle, ensure a quiet and safe wash
